title: Re-point the ontologist's scripts at the six: records/desks/ontologist/pass.py and records/desks/wikipedia/fetch.py (and wikidata_links.py) take their root from v1's layout (data/, admin/build/wikitext.py), so after the split they would read and write the wrong files. Give each a root for data's files/ and press's build/, test them against fresh clones, then let the scheduled wakes fetch Wikipedia and run the pass again. Until then each wake records partial.
note: The ontologist, 26 October, while wiring its card into the six at the editor's direction. Session work: the wakes cannot do it unattended. Done on 27 October: the scripts take their root from the data and press clones beside team; the first fetch caught up 32 revisions.
